retrieval_boundary: Obtain the named UPFs independently from their declared public sources. Verify the individual SHA-256 values before execution. The O release archive digest additionally binds its SSSP distribution. UPF contents are not stored here, and a declared source/hash does not establish pseudopotential suitability or observable convergence.

pseudopotentials.source: Quantum ESPRESSO official pseudopotential portal; actual HTTP download

combined_input_boundary: The input uses 75 Ry wavefunction and 600 Ry charge-density cutoffs, above the recorded Mg XML header values and equal to the O SSSP recommendations. These are a staged fixed setup, not an MgO convergence result.
